stem: The approved recipe specifies Material A, but only a visually similar Material B is available. What should the technician do?
choices: Substitute Material B at the same volume.
Hold the batch and resolve the material-identity discrepancy through the controlled process.
Use half as much Material B as a precaution.
Ask a coworker whether the substitution usually works.
rationale: Hold the batch and resolve the material-identity discrepancy through the controlled process.
